author: KEXP
description: Hailing from New Zealand, the heavy psych rock duo Earth Tongue deliver fuzz-smothered riffs and transcendental rhythms Live on KEXP. With host Jewel Lore, they share a live performance of "Dimly Lit Cadaver" and more.
title: Earth Tongue performs "Dimly Lit Cadaver" & more Live on KEXP
